task: V2 M4 animation components, maps and quality gate
summary: Implemented M4.0-M4.6: an FFmpeg-measured review gate that fails the rejected CLI M1 artifact, a backward-compatible animation schema, frame-deterministic primitives on vendored Onda motion tokens, seven reusable components (title, chapter, bullets, timeline, path, stat, map), multi-element and flubber path morphs, d3-geo maps with animated trade routes, and alignment-aware caption checks. Produced ZIP-native 16:9 and 9:16 demos with frame-identical repeat renders.

model_evidence.notes: All M4 development, testing and demo rendering in Pi. No Codex or Antigravity invocation, no paid API, no model download. TTS candidates were only researched.

items.name: Production and CLI build
items.detail: Client and CLI bundles include flubber and d3-geo.

items.name: Full regression
items.detail: 45 PASS groups including PDF and browser workflows.

items.name: Remotion and Player regression
items.detail: Includes real landscape, portrait and real-media renders.

items.name: Private CLI package
items.detail: Offline npm cache refreshed for new dependencies; 16-entry tarball.

items.name: M4 schema, components and determinism
items.detail: 10 rejection cases, all seven components rendered, two runs frame-identical via framemd5.

items.name: Review gate behaviour
items.detail: Static clip fails; animated passes; deliberate holds configurable; caption drift and proportional alignment rejected.

items.name: Demo review
items.detail: 1280x720, 648 frames, 21.6 s; frozen 27.8%, longest hold 1.033 s, 0 long holds, 8.3 cuts/min, no clipped audio.

items.name: Portrait review
items.detail: 720x1280, 8 s single continuous map shot; frozen 0%; cut-rate check disabled by explicit editorial config.
